description: Defines enums, constants, and a struct for the LoaderAppMetrics API related to crashpad installation status, slot selection status, and ELF library load metrics in the Cobalt project.

methods.name: SetElfLibraryStoredCompressed
methods.description: Sets whether the ELF library is stored compressed.

methods.name: GetElfLibraryStoredCompressed
methods.description: Gets whether the ELF library is stored compressed.

methods.name: SetElfLoadDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Records the ELF load duration in microseconds.

methods.name: GetElfLoadDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Retrieves the ELF load duration in microseconds.

methods.name: SetElfDecompressionDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Records the ELF decompression duration in microseconds.

methods.name: GetElfDecompressionDurationMicroseconds
methods.description: Retrieves the ELF decompression duration in microseconds.

methods.name: RecordUsedCpuBytesDuringElfLoad
methods.description: Records the maximum CPU bytes used during ELF load.

methods.name: GetMaxSampledUsedCpuBytesDuringElfLoad
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum CPU bytes used during ELF load.
